title: Dawn's Judgment
request: A dawn can expose the wicked or shelter the weary. Bring an offering, then choose what your light will mean.

a.name: Judgment

reward.description: Solar Ward lasts 15 seconds instead of 10

a.ending: You faced what others feared to name. Let your light endure: judgment need not be cruelty.

b.name: Sanctuary

reward.description: Solar Ward can activate below 65% health instead of 50%

b.ending: You made room beneath the dawn for the hungry. Your shelter, too, is justice.
